name: Money-Watch — Bank Reconciliation (multi-user, multi-bank)
notes: Generated from money-watch supabase/docs — the vault-destroying overwrite path (sync_bank_to_app with p_cleared_balance -> current_balance) is *not* used. Ledger moves by drift (reported - ledger) and a visible `reconciliation` row is written. Per-user bank_accounts are the unit: see docs/make_migration.md. Validate against 20261004100000..100500 before wiring live funds. Connection IDs below are YOUR existing ones (5184148 = google-email on gs35421gamer, 5259937 = supabase Money-Watch) — re-use yours, do not paste a snapshot of the service key.

parameters.q: from:(firstbank.com OR gtbank.com OR uba-group.com OR accessbankplc.com OR zenithbank.com) subject:("Debit" OR "Credit" OR "Alert") has:attachment OR has:link

__IMTCONN__.label: My Gmail connection — multiplex per user: each friend adds their own google-email connection with a distinct label (bank_accounts.label), kept as a scenario note

metadata.notes: Synonym table: GTB says 'Available Bal', UBA 'Avl. Bal', Zenith 'Ledger Balance'. The bank is now authoritative but VISIBLY: p_reported_balance is what the bank reported, drift is (reported - ledger). The old Amount ($1) field is no longer sent — see module 56. Token family is parseNumber({{53.$1}}; "."; ","), not the backtick form ( Make v2 quirk — use $1 per module).

Pre-step required (not in this snapshot): a Supabase 'Make an API Call' that does GET /rest/v1/bank_accounts?label=eq.Primary&select=id&user_id=eq.{{43.__IMTCONN__}}>auth.uid mapping — Make multiplexes per Gmail connection: each user has a dedicated connection with a scenario-level label (bank_accounts.label), so no p_user_id is hardcoded. Result alias is 'lookup'. The stale body was sync_bank_to_app with p_user_id cff8115a... and p_cleared_balance. If the lookup returns 0 rows, branch to a no-op so a variant-format email does not emit current_balance = p_cleared_balance (that was the unsafe fallback).
Same synonym branch as Debit. In make.com the `sensitive` toggle is true by default — set to false so 'credit' matches 'CREDIT' across banks.

Credit was load-bearing: your old scenario's filter was text:contain:ci but the parser path was sensitive:true, so a 'CREDIT' subject could route Debit:true / Credit:false and parse as Debit. Kept both routes but made the invariant explicit so Credit is not a fall-through.

importNotes: Import: make.com -> Scenarios -> ⋮ -> Import blueprint. It will prompt to re-bind __IMTCONN__ 5184148 and 5259937 to your workspace. Do not paste the service key into the blueprint file; it is Make-managed.

Required before first live run: run supabase/migrations/ 20261004100000..100500 on the linked project, then smoke one Debit and one Credit Gmail alert and verify the dashboard's reconciliation badge (not the old overwrite's bank_balance-only delta).
